item.description: The SubprocessCLITransport class is missing the read_messages method that tests expect, and has a mismatch between method names (receive_messages vs read_messages). Tests also expect an is_ready method that doesn't exist.
item.contract: 1. Add a read_messages method that provides the same functionality as receive_messages for backward compatibility. 2. Add an is_ready method that returns a boolean indicating if the transport is ready for communication. 3. Both methods should be implemented to satisfy existing test expectations.

item.description: ClaudeCodeOptions constructor doesn't accept 'env' parameter that tests expect, causing TypeError when constructing options with custom environment variables.
item.contract: Add an 'env' parameter to ClaudeCodeOptions.__init__ that allows passing custom environment variables to the subprocess.

item.description: The SubprocessCLITransport class doesn't properly implement async iteration protocols needed for the streaming client tests, causing 'async for' to fail with 'requires an object with __aiter__ method' errors.
item.contract: Ensure the transport properly supports async iteration by implementing the necessary methods and returning proper async iterators.

item.description: The message parser doesn't handle ThinkingBlock content in assistant messages correctly, causing test failures when parsing messages with thinking content.
item.contract: Update the parse_message function to properly handle thinking content blocks in assistant messages by adding a case for "thinking" type content blocks.

item.description: The SubprocessCLITransport class is missing proper context manager integration for connect/disconnect behavior that tests expect.
item.contract: Add proper context manager support (connect/disconnect) and ensure close() method is called correctly in tests that expect it.
